interaction.input: Enter on a named point in the primary divergence chart
interaction.latencyDefinition: milliseconds from the chart selection handler to the linked reader heading commit

notes: The median selection commit is below the 100 ms engineering target on this declared device and dataset.
The p95 and maximum retain occasional main-thread outliers; this report is a performance baseline rather than a universal guarantee.
The secondary scatterplot remains pointer and hover interactive; the primary divergence chart and results table provide the keyboard path.
